integrity: The proof independently derives the adjoint-lattice and integral-subgroup direct-product identities, hence multiplicativity of the two symplectic integrality indices. It then applies the primary source's exact one-window and multiwindow classification at the product dimension. Eventual activation follows from exponential growth of the index gap versus linear dimension growth. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The result is an existence and exact window-count theorem for symplectically rational direct-product lattices. It does not construct the activating one-window Schwartz frame explicitly, classify its shape, or provide frame bounds. The activating window need not factor as a tensor product.
title: Direct-product activation of Schwartz Gabor windows
